items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: Ellis Burden asked me who we could get from New Orleans... to have around because... the music wasn't important... having the music, that's just a come-on for people to come... Kansas City with Ellis Burden

ctx.x: You worked with Bunk Johnson in Kansas City...

Let me tell you, Ellis Burden asked me who we could get from New Orleans, you know, that...just to have around because... the music wasn't important, you see. He had a gambling house. See..these...it's just like a gambling house...and having the music, that's just a come-on for people to come, and the man to bring his lady, and she'll listen to the music and he'll go back and gamble. Same way as we talked about a record...making records...having a record store. Well, you get your shoes shined and you hear a…
Let's see now...what did I say...
